fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image Alt Text
fields.description: Describe the image for screen readers and SEO.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading & Intro
fields.value:
Be the first to know

Leave your details and we'll tell you when reservations open, before anyone else hears about it.

fields.name: consent
fields.label: Consent Text
fields.value: I agree to JSW Motors storing my details and contacting me about the launch, reservations and related updates over email, SMS, WhatsApp and phone, as in the Privacy Notice.

fields.name: redirect
fields.label: Thank-you Page Link
fields.description: Page to redirect to after a successful registration. Internal path (e.g. /thank-you) or a full URL.

fields.name: requestSent
fields.label: Request Sent Pop-up
fields.description: Booking only (used when the Thank-you Page Link is empty). The heading is the pop-up's title (e.g. Request sent to Meridian Motors); each paragraph starting with a bold label is a row (e.g. **Dealer** Meridian Motors, Plot 14, Sector 54, Golf Course Road, Gurgaon); a plain paragraph is the status line (e.g. Waiting for Meridian Motors to call you); a link is the outlined button beside Done (e.g. Explore the Combat to #combat). The visitor's email and contact are added automatically.

fields.name: mapName
fields.label: Map Pop-up Name
fields.description: Booking only. The bold line of the pop-up over the map's pin, e.g. Meridian Motors.

fields.name: mapAddress
fields.label: Map Address
fields.description: Booking only. The address the Google map shows and marks, e.g. Plot 14, Sector 54, Gurgaon; also the pop-up's second line. With it the map replaces the Decorative Image (which stays as the fallback); clicking the map opens the address in Google Maps.

fields.name: mapCoordinates
fields.label: Map Coordinates
fields.description: Booking only. The dealer's latitude and longitude, comma-separated, e.g. 28°26' N, 77°06' E (or 28.4333, 77.1). Clicking the map and Get directions go to this exact point in Google Maps (else to the Map Address); the Find Us Card also shows them at the top corners of its drawing.

fields.name: wayfindRegion
fields.label: Find Us: Region
fields.description: Find Us Card only. Under the pin on the map drawing, e.g. Gurugram · Haryana.

fields.name: wayfindCity
fields.label: Find Us: City
fields.description: Find Us Card only. Beside the pin icon under the address, e.g. Gurugram, India.

fields.name: wayfindPin
fields.label: Find Us: PIN Code
fields.description: Find Us Card only. The postal code, e.g. 122011 (shown as PIN 122011).

fields.name: wayfindNote
fields.label: Find Us: Closing Line
fields.description: Find Us Card only. The line along the card's foot, e.g. We look forward to meeting you.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Default: the registration form. Booking: the dealer microsite's quote request: the details (email optional, pincode as in Default), then the OTP and the Request Sent pop-ups; the lead is sent with source Dealer Microsite and channel Digital. The Decorative Image is the map beside it.

fields.name: classes_wayfind
fields.label: Find Us Card
fields.description: Booking only. The right side shows a Find us card instead of the map: an Our showroom map drawing, the dealer's name (Map Pop-up Name) and address (Map Address), city and PIN, a Get directions button to Google Maps and a closing line. The form on the left is unchanged.
